dailyGuide.nutritionTip: Intermittent fasting: skip breakfast and make lunch the first meal; use porridge + banana + honey only before a run over 12 km. Target ~500 kcal below estimated TDEE (not BMR): 1800 rest/football, 1900–2000 easy short runs, 2000 strength or longer-run rebuild days; protein 130g most days and 140g on strength days.
dailyGuide.sleepTip: Weekday bedtime averages ~00:13 — that is the main lever. Aim earlier (target ~23:00) for better rebuild recovery.
